games.desc:
Journey across the continent in an expedition group whose goal is to survey and explore dangerous territory.

You will ride from pole-to-pole, crossing through various biomes, whether it be:
--Tropical savannas teeming with wildlife
--Dry deserts, baked by the hot scorching sun
--Valleys with goats and cattle in between the tall mountains
--Cold, icey polar regions, where the sun dances around

Becareful however, as bandits fill the area, raiding settlements, disrupting trade routes, and waging conflict with government forces.

games.name: Build a Dinosaur
games.desc:
🦖 The dinosaur museum is in chaos! Fossil bones are scattered everywhere. Collect them and rebuild every dinosaur skeleton to restore the museum.

🎮 How to Play

🦴 Collect & Rebuild – Search every corner of the museum, gather scattered fossil bones, and rebuild all 6 dinosaur skeletons.

📈 Upgrade – Complete skeletons to earn cash and unlock powerful upgrades to restore the museum even faster.

👥 Play Together – Restore the museum solo or team up with friends.

🏆 Compete – Beat the clock and climb the global leaderboards with the fastest completion times.
